note: 整段参考译文为公开机器翻译接口生成的初稿，非官方译文，仅用于对照理解。

reading-text-1.label: 阅读 Text 1
reading-text-1.title: 2022 考研英语二 阅读 Text 1

paragraphs.en: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown’s 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas. Some rest in the shade of a parked car. Others drink water with the cows. This all seems random, but it’s by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近一个阳光明媚的日子里，13,000只鸡在拉里·布朗位于德克萨斯州夏纳的40英亩狂风肆虐的土地上漫步。一些鸡在停着的汽车的阴凉处休息。另一些鸡和奶牛一起喝水。这一切看起来都是随机的，但这是设计好的，这是价值61亿美元的美国鸡蛋行业押注的下一件大事的一部分：气候友好型鸡蛋。

paragraphs.en: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they’re also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases. Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change.
paragraphs.zh: 这些鸡蛋现在以每打8美元的价格在货架上首次亮相，它们仍然被贴上有机和动物友好的标签，但它们也来自那些生活在农场的鸟类，这些农场使用再生农业特殊技术来培育可以捕获温室气体的肥沃土壤。这种鸡蛋可以作为帮助应对气候变化的产品进行销售。

paragraphs.en: “I’m excited about our progress,” says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based NestFresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds’ waste then fertilizes fields. Such improvements “allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers.” The egg industry’s push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering. In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart. More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories. If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond. Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine. Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
paragraphs.zh: “我对我们的进步感到兴奋，”布朗说，他为丹佛的NestFresh Eggs收获鸡蛋，并增加了更多的覆盖作物，这些作物可以吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用。鸟类的排泄物然后会给田地施肥。这种改进“使我们的母鸡能够寻找更高质量的天然饲料，这对土地和母鸡都有好处，以及我们向客户提供的鸡蛋。”鸡蛋行业的推动是对再生农场的动物产品是否能成为下一个优质产品的第一次重大考验。在不到十年的时间里，有机鸡蛋从天然食品店的小众产品到沃尔玛的销售，最近也出现了类似的对益生菌和植物性肉类的质疑，但这两种产品都已迅速成为超市的主要产品类别。如果可持续鸡蛋的推广成功，它可能会打开再生牛肉、西兰花等产品的闸门。再生产品可能很难销售，宾夕法尼亚州立大学白兰地酒农业经济学副教授朱莉·斯坦顿说，因为这个概念很坚韧很快定义，这种养殖方式也给食品带来了最小的改善（如果有的话）（尽管一些生产商说他们的鸡蛋含有更多的蛋白质）。

paragraphs.en: The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability. Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment. Young adults “really care about the planet,” says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations. “They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they’re doing.”
paragraphs.zh: 该行业认为，那些为自由放养、非转基因和牧场饲养的鸡蛋等优质产品支付更多费用的消费者，也会接受可持续性。调查显示，年轻一代更关心气候变化，植物性肉类的一些成功可以归因于消费者希望表达他们保护环境的愿望。年轻人“真的关心地球，鸡蛋创新公司总裁约翰·布伦奎尔说，“他们绝对是在改变食物链，我认为他们甚至不知道自己在做什么。”

reading-text-2.label: 阅读 Text 2
reading-text-2.title: 2022 考研英语二 阅读 Text 2

paragraphs.en: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的美国人选择在退休后继续工作，这一日益增长的趋势有可能颠覆旧的劳动力模式。

paragraphs.en: One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement to prepare for a longer life, according to a survey conducted by Harris Poll for TD Ameritrade. Even more surprising is that more than half of “unretirees”— those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
paragraphs.zh: 哈里斯民意调查公司为德美利证券公司进行的一项调查显示，在至少40岁的美国人中，有三分之一的人已经或计划在退休后找一份工作，为更长的寿命做准备。更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”--那些计划退休后工作或退休后重返工作岗位的人--表示，即使他们有足够的钱安顿下来，他们也会在晚年找到工作，调查显示，

paragraphs.en: Financial needs aren’t the only culprit for the “unretirement” trend. Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression. About 72% of “unretiree” respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet.
paragraphs.zh: 经济需求并不是导致“未退休”趋势的唯一原因。根据这项研究，其他原因包括个人满足感，如保持精神健康、防止无聊或避免抑郁。约72%的“未退休”受访者表示，他们将在退休后重返工作岗位，以保持精神健康，而59%的人表示，这将与维持生计有关。

paragraphs.en: “The concept of retirement is evolving,” said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade. “It’s not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement.”
paragraphs.zh: TD Ameritrade退休事务高级经理克莉丝汀·拉塞尔（Christine Russell）表示：“退休的概念正在演变。这不仅与财务有关。工作的价值也在驱使人们在退休后继续工作。”

paragraphs.en: One reason for the change in retirement patterns: Americans are living longer. The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That’s also up 302% since 2010. Older Americans are also the fastest-growing segment of the U.S. workforce, and boomers are expected to live longer than previous generations. The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades. About 20% of people 65 and older were in the workforce in February, up from an all-time low of 10% in January 1985, according to money manager United Income. Because of longer life spans, Americans are also boosting their savings to preserve their nest eggs, the TD Ameritrade study showed, which surveyed 2,000 adults between 40 to 79. Six in 10 “unretirees” are increasing their savings in anticipation of a longer life, according to the survey. Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts. Unfortunately, many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth. He suggested that preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals.
paragraphs.zh: 退休模式发生变化的原因之一是：美国人的寿命更长了。根据美国人口普查局的数据，2018年65岁及以上人口的比例为16%，比前一年增长了32%。自2010年以来，这一比例也增长了302%。美国老年人也是美国劳动力中增长最快的群体，婴儿潮一代的寿命预计将比前几代人更长。在过去30年里，退休年龄的人在劳动力中所占的比例翻了一番。2月份，65岁及以上的人中约有20%在劳动力中，根据基金管理公司United Income的数据，这一比例从1985年1月10%的历史最低点上升。TD Ameritrade的研究显示，由于寿命延长，美国人也在增加储蓄，以保存他们的养老金。调查显示，十分之六的“未退休者”正在增加储蓄，以期待更长的寿命。该公司说，他们最流行的储蓄方式之一是减少总支出，确保人寿保险或最大限度地提高他们对退休账户的贡献。不幸的是，许多选择退休后工作的人正准备这样做，因为他们担心在晚年入不敷出，布伦特韦斯说，他建议即将退休的人应该咨询财务顾问，制定长期财务目标。

paragraphs.en: “The most challenging moments in life are getting married, starting a family and ultimately retiring,” Weiss said. “It’s not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can’t retire.”
paragraphs.zh: 韦斯说：“人生中最具挑战性的时刻是结婚、组建家庭和最终退休。这不仅仅是一个财务上的决定，也是一个情感上的决定。许多人认为自己不能退休。”

reading-text-3.label: 阅读 Text 3
reading-text-3.title: 2022 考研英语二 阅读 Text 3

paragraphs.en: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives. Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 在个人生活和职业生活中，我们都遇到过这样的情况。想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的时刻吧，会员或订阅的注册过程是天衣无缝的，但后来却很难取消。一些本应简单透明的事情可能会有意或无意地变得复杂，从而损害消费者的选择。这些都是黑暗模式的例子。

paragraphs.en: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, “dark patterns” is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to “roach motel,” where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out.
paragraphs.zh: 用户体验专家Harry Brignull于2010年首次提出“黑暗模式”，这是一个包罗万象的术语，指的是操纵用户界面以影响用户决策能力的做法。Brignull确定了12种常见的黑暗模式，从误导和隐藏成本到“蟑螂汽车旅馆”，在这种模式下，用户体验在开始时似乎很简单直观，但是当使用者试图离开时变得困难。

paragraphs.en: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
paragraphs.zh: 在2019年对53，000个产品页面和11，000个网站进行的一项研究中，研究人员发现，大约十分之一的人采用了这些设计实践。虽然广泛流行，但黑暗模式的概念仍然没有得到很好的理解。商业和非营利组织领导者应该意识到黑暗模式，并尽量避免它们产生的灰色区域。

paragraphs.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company’s user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding “digital deception.”
paragraphs.zh: 道德的、有说服力的设计和黑暗模式之间的界限在哪里？企业应与IT、合规、风险和法律的团队进行对话，以审查其隐私政策，并在讨论中包括负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账篮、定价、和促销。任何或所有这些团队都可以在创建或避免“数字欺骗”方面发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that “ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights.” The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using “confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn’t opt out.” As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
paragraphs.zh: 立法者和监管机构正在慢慢开始解决围绕黑暗模式的模糊性，最近一次是在州一级。加州总检察长宣布批准《加州消费者隐私法》（CCPA）下的附加法规，以“确保消费者在寻求行使其数据隐私权时不会被混淆或误导”。这些法规旨在禁止黑暗模式-这意味着禁止公司使用“令人困惑的语言或不必要的步骤，如强迫他们点击多个屏幕或听取他们不应该选择退出的理由”。随着越来越多的州考虑颁布额外的规定，企业界内部需要更大的责任感。黑暗模式也可以在自我监管的基础上解决，但前提是组织要承担责任，不仅符合法律的要求，而且符合行业最佳实践和标准。

reading-text-4.label: 阅读 Text 4
reading-text-4.title: 2022 考研英语二 阅读 Text 4

paragraphs.en: Although ethics classes are common around the world, scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior; evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports. But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管道德课程在世界各地很普遍，但科学家们不确定这些课程是否真的能改变行为;无论哪种方式，证据都很薄弱，依赖于人为的实验室测试，有时还依赖于不可靠的自我报告。但发表在《认知》杂志上的一项新研究发现，在至少一种现实情况下，一堂道德课可能会产生持久的影响。

paragraphs.en: The researchers investigated one class session’s impact on eating meat. They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students’ attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering. Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion. The other half focused on charitable giving instead. Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester— nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员调查了一节课对吃肉的影响。研究报告的合著者、加州大学滨江分校的哲学家埃里克·施维茨格贝尔说，他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因：学生对这一主题的态度是多变和不稳定的，行为是很容易衡量的，和伦理学文献基本上都同意少吃肉是好的，因为它减少了对环境的伤害和动物的痛苦。研究人员让一组学生观看了一段11分钟的视频，另一组学生参加了一场50分钟的讨论。另一组学生则专注于慈善捐赠。然后，在学生们不知情的情况下，研究人员研究了他们在该学期匿名购买的餐卡--近500名学生的近1.4万张收据。

paragraphs.en: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books. But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study’s duration of several weeks. Purchases from the other group remained at 52 percent.
paragraphs.zh: 施维茨格贝尔预测，干预将不会有任何效果;他之前发现，伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授没有区别，包括投票率、献血和归还图书馆书籍。但在讨论肉类伦理学的学生中，含肉膳食购买量从52%下降到45%-在研究的几周时间里，这一效果一直保持稳定。从另一组购买的比例保持在52%。

paragraphs.en: “That’s actually a pretty large effect for a pretty small intervention,” Schwitzgebel says. Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable. And if real, she notes, it might be reversible by another nudge: “Easy come, easy go.” Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence— classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common. Second, the video may have had an emotional impact. Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument, although his co-authors say reason might play a bigger role. Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants’ eating habits and students’ video exposure. Meanwhile, Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.
paragraphs.zh: “这实际上是一个相当小的干预措施的相当大的影响，”Schwitzgebel说。宾夕法尼亚大学的心理学家Nina Strohminger没有参与这项研究，她说她希望这种影响是真实的，但不能排除一些未知的混淆变量。她指出，如果真实的，它可能是通过另一个推动逆转的：“来得容易，去得也快。”施维茨格贝尔认为，最大的影响来自社会影响--领导讨论的同学或助教可能分享了他们自己的素食主义，表明素食主义是可以实现的，或者更普遍。其次，视频可能产生了情感影响。最不令人振奋的是，他认为，这是一个理性的论点，尽管他的合著者说，理性可能起着更大的作用。现在，研究人员正在探索教学风格、助教的饮食习惯和学生接触视频的具体影响。与此同时，曾预测没有影响的施维茨格贝尔将收回他的话。
